No supplied paper directly addresses “Shukla generative recommendation hierarchical supervision” beyond the general hierarchical-supervision generative recommendation framing. The closest match is HASTE (Tripti Shukla et al.), which proposes Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for generative recommendation by explicitly incorporating hierarchical and attribute-level supervision into the generative training objective [1]. It uses a Hierarchical Loss to exploit the multi-level structure of semantic IDs with supervision at each hierarchy level, and Attribute-Specific Losses to preserve fine-grained item attributes, improving long-tail performance and training efficiency [1].

Other supplied generative recommendation papers also involve hierarchical ideas but differ in focus: HoloRec uses hierarchical semantic encoding and interleaved reasoning mechanisms for generative recommendation [2], while HRPO performs hierarchical residual policy optimization at the level of SID prefix utilities for post-training with outcome feedback [4].
